description: This bar chart, titled "Evaluation Based on Different Tasks," displays accuracy scores for three different models—labeled in the legend as "Base" (red), "RMU with Enhanced GCG" (light green), and "RMU" (light yellow)—across two evaluation tasks: "MCQ Eval" and "Generation Eval." The vertical axis represents "Accuracy," scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, and the horizontal axis lists the two evaluation tasks. For each task, there are three stacked bars, with the "Base" model forming the bottom segment, "RMU with Enhanced GCG" in the middle, and "RMU" on top. In the "MCQ Eval" group, the "Base" model achieves an accuracy of 0.644, the "RMU with Enhanced GCG" model achieves 0.539, and the "RMU" model achieves 0.299. In the "Generation Eval" group, the "Base" model achieves an accuracy of 0.597, the "RMU with Enhanced GCG" model achieves 0.263, and the "RMU" model achieves 0.106. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the evaluation tasks on the horizontal axis.
